overview.headline: Steps to register to vote through different methods

keyPoints.point: Students learn that eligible people can vote in federal, state and local elections after registering.
keyPoints.quote: Learn how to register so you can vote in federal, state, and local elections.

keyPoints.point: Students learn that voters select a state or territory to find instructions for the registration process.
Students learn that citizens can register in person at a local election office as well as online or by mail.
keyPoints.quote: In person at your local election office

keyPoints.point: Students learn that required documents to register vary by state and may include a license or other proof.
keyPoints.quote: The required documents you need to register vary by state.
